$meta.name: boopis design system v7 (proposal)
$meta.status: proposal for the owner; nothing in the app reads this file yet
$meta.source: Grok Bot desktop 1.2.3 measured values (grok-package/grokbot-design/tokens.json, Part A section 2) as the starting values; boopis keeps its character (orb2 orbs, the wordmark and logo, the bots' colours, its vocabulary) and its accessibility floors
$meta.format: each token: css (the custom property the kit reads), dark and light (or value when it does not change with the theme), v6 (what it replaces), grok (the measured source), use. Options the owner picks are in options; defaults below are the recommended pick of each.
$meta.generator: docs/design/v7/build-v7-css.mjs writes tokens.v7.css from this file

ink.use: the one neutral; every text, line and fill below is this ink at an alpha step

bg-sidebar.use: the sidebar and the rail; the deepest surface

bg-chrome.use: the window and the ground the work sits on; the floating chrome sits on it

bg-pane.use: the details panel and other side panes that push the work

bg-elevated.use: cards, settings cards, menus, popovers, dialogs, the composer, tooltips, toasts, floating chrome buttons

bg-elevated-hover.use: a hovered row on an elevated surface; pressed fills; the scrollbar thumb

bg-well.grok: code box of the approval card (sampled)
bg-well.use: wells only: code, terminal output, diffs. Cards are no longer inset (R-colour-4 changes)

dock.use: owner decision kept: the dock is pitch black in both themes and is never themeable

text-strong.use: names, titles, the current row; equal to --text in v7 (kept as a name so modules need no change)

text-dim.use: everything secondary a person must read: descriptions, timestamps, section headings, meta, state words, costs. 7.3:1 on elevated (dark), 5.4:1 (light)

text-quiet.use: placeholders and labelling glyphs only. Never meta a person must read: it is 3.7:1 in light (R-a11y-8). Meta moves to --text-dim

icon.use: glyphs in icon buttons and rows

icon-quiet.use: window controls, the composer's + and mic, labelling glyphs; 3:1 floor holds (5.4 dark, 3.7 light)

mark-off.use: inactive non-text marks (page dots, empty rings): 3.36:1 dark, 3.1:1 light, kept for WCAG 1.4.11

fill-quaternary.use: the faintest wash: skeleton rest, disabled secondary

fill-secondary.use: the composer's round buttons, chips at rest, the agent bubble, letter tiles

hover.use: row, icon button and chip hover

current.use: the selected row, the active nav item, the current rail tile, the highlighted palette row

hair.use: dividers between groups, the agent bubble's ring

line.use: the outline of every elevated thing: floating buttons, menus, dialogs, the composer at rest

line-strong.use: hovered outlines, the composer focused, attachment cards

line-field.use: a text field's outline: kept at 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11); Grok's 22% is the one place v7 does not follow Grok

float-line.grok: dark 6% hairline; light: the shadow's 1px ring, almost nothing
float-line.use: the outline of menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, dialogs and settings cards: in light the shadow carries the edge (light-shadow option A; B 12%, C 18%)

composer-line.use: the composer's outline at rest; focused it takes --line-field

specular.use: the inset top and bottom light on elevated surfaces and the agent bubble, dark only

specular-strong.use: the top-most layer's 1px top highlight (Grok gap 9: stacked dialogs)

selected.use: the primary pill, the send button, the active filter chip: inverted ink

accent.use: option A (recommended): the switch when on, the chosen letter tile, the progress fill. A fill, never text

accent-text.use: links, the info banner's text: 6.6:1 dark, 5.1:1 light

on-accent.grok: white on the blue switch and letter tile
on-accent.use: the knob of a switch that is on, the letter of a chosen option; under accent option B it becomes the inverted ink

focus.use: the 2px focus ring: kept (R-focus-1, WCAG 2.4.7), in the accent text colour

attention.use: option B of the attention board (recommended): what the person owes, as dots, stamps, the 'you' capsule's ring; also failed and a destructive confirm

attention-text.use: 'needs you', 'failed' and error lines: 6.5:1 dark, 5.6:1 light

attention-soft.use: behind a message addressed to you

warn.use: option A of the attention board: Grok's 'needs you' dot and words; under option B, a warning that is not owed

ok.use: the online dot, a connected mark, a passed gate's dot

bubble-agent.use: a bot's message; dark adds the specular ring and a 3% top gradient

bubble-user.use: your message: 18% ink in dark, solid ink in light

find.use: find-in-chat matches; the current match one step stronger

scrim.use: behind dialogs and the palette; never blurred

sans.use: option A of the font board (recommended): Geist, SIL OFL 1.1, already bundled (@fontsource/geist). B: Inter (OFL 1.1). C: Figtree (OFL 1.1)

mono.use: code, paths, numbers that line up, keys. No longer for state words or model names (R-type-1 changes)

tracking.use: letter-spacing of every sans step; --track-s 0.015em at 13px

weights.use: 400 nearly everything (buttons, tabs, menus, rows included); 500 page titles and a bot's name in the title pill; 600 dialog titles and a question card's question. Hierarchy by alpha, not weight

fs-xs.use: timestamps, section headings, tooltips, captions, state words

fs-s.use: settings rows, inputs, row subtitles, palette subtitles

fs-m.use: menus, buttons, the composer, row names, settings labels

fs-xl.use: a page title (500), the bot name field

pill.grok: buttons, chips, toggles, icon buttons, title pill
pill.use: every button, icon button, chip, segmented track and thumb, switch, the title pill, the search pill, the one-line composer, avatars

composer.use: the composer box (a pill at one line, 22 as it grows)

bubble.use: messages, question cards, inline cards in a conversation (approval, connector, plan, file)

dialog-form.use: form dialogs (new bot, confirm, a long-text editor), 440 to 488 wide

card.use: settings cards, the large dialogs (Settings, Store, Keyboard), the palette, kanban cards

tile.use: the rail tile, the expanded sidebar row, item marks at 40

field.grok: select trigger 10, menu row 10, toast 10, input 8
field.use: fields, selects, a menu row, toasts, the info banner, wells

nav.use: settings nav rows, palette rows, key chips in a field

tip.use: tooltips, the question card's letter tile

kbd.use: key chips in running text, inline code

slab.use: the dock's slab and flares and the approved notch's shape only: kept so the notch spec (section 2.1) and the dock stay as approved

floor.grok: the smallest nested radius in Grok (menu 16, inset 6, row 10; palette 14, 6, 8)
floor.use: the smallest inner radius of a nested corner

smoothing.use: option B of the radius board (recommended): boopis's continuous corner kept at Grok's radii. Option A sets 0 (Grok's plain arc)

nesting.rule: unchanged from v6 8.2: --r-in = max(--r-floor, --r-outer - --pad); a piece too small to be that round moves in until its curve shares the corner's centre (corners.ts); a round piece in a pill stays a pill. Grok's own numbers already satisfy it, which is why v7 can keep the rule and take Grok's values

dialog.grok: the close button (28) 10 in from a 20 form dialog

card.grok: settings card rows are full-bleed; a nested piece takes 6

bubble.grok: approval card: code box 10 inside an 18 card

named.bubble-gap: 6 between consecutive bubbles of one sender, 16 between senders, 24 to a time separator
named.settings-row: 16 horizontal, 44 to 52 tall by content; card padding 8 0

ctl-card.grok: a button inside a settings card 32

hit-min.grok: 28 composer buttons (Grok gap 3 says 32; 28 keeps the composer's geometry and passes WCAG 2.5.8)

drag-h.grok: the top 56 is a drag region, no bar drawn

col-w.grok: the column is the bubbles' width; the composer is wider

orbs.use: 10 the dock pill, 16 the activity line and card minis, 20 lists and mentions, 24 the title pill and room bylines, 28 the compact rail, 36 the rail tile and sidebar rows, 40 the dock row, 64 the details header, 96 the new-bot preview

dark.rule: no shadows. Depth is surface steps (#0e0e0e < #121212 < #161616 < #1f1f1f < #2c2c2c), a 1 device px --line outline, and an inset --spec top and bottom line
dark.--elev-3: inset 0 1px 0 var(--spec-strong) on the top-most floating layer only

light.rule: option A of the light-shadow board (recommended): Grok's shadows as measured

hairline.value: 1 device px (0.5px at 2x, 0.625px at 1.6x); the squircle snaps it as in v6 8.1

--spring.use: layout travel: sidebar, panel, tiles; unchanged

--ease-drawer.use: the details pane and side sheets

--dur-pop.use: menus, popovers, tooltips, the palette: from scale(.98) and 2-4px toward the anchor

--dur-slide.use: the sidebar, the rail tiles, a segmented thumb

--dur-3.use: card height (owner decision), the composer's growth, the dock's springs

--dur-shimmer.use: option C of the status board: the activity phrase's sweep

--dur-hold-phrase.use: a status phrase stays at least this long before it changes

motion.reduced: unchanged from v6: durations become 1ms, loops stop (the shimmer included), travel becomes a cross-fade, orbs reduce and never freeze

choices.A: Grok exact: its radii as plain arcs
choices.B: Grok's radii, boopis's continuous corner and concentric rule
choices.C: rounder: every step one notch up (cards 18, dialogs 24, menus 20, bubbles 22)
flat like dark: hairlines and surface steps only

choices.A: orb2 as it is: its dark eyes
choices.B: cut-out eyes: the eyes take the surface colour
choices.C: the orb in a tile (8% fill), as Grok's rail

choices.A: Grok: floating sidebar toggle, title pill (orb + name, opens details), search and details pills; no bar
choices.B: the same plus a centred search pill that keeps boopis's command field
choices.C: an unfilled 40px bar holding v6's controls, no line

choices.A: Grok: a 44 pill, + left, mic and voice-or-send right, nothing else
choices.B: the pill plus boopis's mode chips (Governed, Smart, the model) on a second line inside, 22 radius once it grows
choices.C: the pill alone, the mode chips as a quiet line under it

choices.A: a breathing dot and the phrase (calm pass default)
choices.C: Grok: the live 16px orb and the phrase with a 2.2s shimmer

status.recommended: C for a bot, A where there is no bot

choices.A: a collapsed Danger zone at the page's end
choices.B: the overflow menu in the header

danger.recommended: B on sheets and panes, A on Settings pages

choices.A: the calm pass's (i): a 12-radius circle, stroke 1.5
choices.B: a filled 16px disc with a knocked-out i
choices.C: no glyph: the label is dotted-underlined and opens the popover

choices.A: a centred form dialog (720 x 640, radius 20)
choices.B: a full focused view over the work, the chrome kept

choices.A: Grok blue #116dd2 for the switch, links, focus
choices.B: ink: the accent is the inverted ink (Grok's 'Black' accent)

choices.A: Grok: 'needs you' in warn amber, red only for failed and destructive
choices.B: boopis: what you owe stays red (the 'you' capsule, the notch's edge), in Grok's red values
